title: Gaufres de Bruxelles
notes: Yeast check: use yeast within its use-by date. There is no blooming step, so the rise is the only test; if the batter has not visibly grown after an hour the yeast was dead. Rescue: whisk in 10 g of baking powder, skip straight to the whites and cook immediately. The result is good, just less complex.
Fresh yeast instead: half a 42 g cube, about 21 g, crumbled into the warm liquid.
Overnight version: refrigerate the batter once mixed, up to 12 h, take it out 30 min before cooking and carry on with the rise. Better flavour.
Freezing: cool the waffles completely and freeze flat in a bag. Revive from frozen at 180 °C conventional / 160 °C fan for 5 min on a rack.

ingredients.name: egg
ingredients.prep: separated, whites covered at room temperature

steps.text: Warm {milk} and {water} together to lukewarm, about 35 °C, neutral on the inside of your wrist. TM7: 2 min / 37 °C / speed 2
Melt {butter} and set it aside. It must be no more than lukewarm before it meets the batter.
Whisk {flour}, {yeast}, {caster-sugar} and {salt} in a large bowl.
Add {vanilla}, the warm liquid and the yolks of {eggs}. Whisk until smooth, then whisk in the melted butter.
Cover the bowl and leave at room temperature until doubled, domed and visibly bubbly.
Heat the waffle iron at about three-quarters of its thermostat range. Give it the full time before the first waffle.
Whip the whites in a clean grease-free bowl to soft peaks, a tip that droops when you lift the whisk. TM7: 3 min / speed 4, butterfly
Fold a third of the whites into the risen batter to loosen it, then fold in the rest, stopping as soon as the streaks disappear. Use the batter within 30 min.
Now, and not before, whip {cream} with {icing-sugar-chantilly} to soft peaks in a cold bowl, stopping early: it keeps thickening as you spoon it. Refrigerate until serving.
Pour a large ladleful of batter into the centre of each plate. Close the lid gently, let it ride up as the waffle grows and do not press it down.
Bake until deep gold and the steam from the sides has almost stopped. Lift a corner to check before opening fully.
Move the waffles to a wire rack. Let the iron come back up to temperature before the next pour.
Serve within a few minutes, with the chantilly.
Optional: top with {strawberries} and a dusting of {icing-sugar-dusting}.
